card.line: Baal-zephon was an Egyptian town by the Gulf of Suez, and the Israelites camped opposite it just before God opened the sea for them.

moments.title: God sets the camp
moments.text: The LORD told Moses to have the Israelites turn back and camp by the sea, directly opposite Baal-zephon. He said Pharaoh would think they were boxed in, and that He would gain honor by means of Pharaoh and his army.

moments.title: Pharaoh catches up
moments.text: Pharaoh took his chariots and army and chased Israel. The Egyptians overtook the Israelites as they camped by the sea near Pi-hahiroth, opposite Baal-zephon. The people were terrified, and Moses told them the LORD would fight for them.

moments.title: A stop on the journey
moments.text: The list of Israel's travels says they set out from Etham and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, opposite Baal-zephon. They camped near Migdol, and then they crossed through the sea.
